requirements: docs/21 modbit-guest / Execution profiles (cloud_isolated) / Sandbox substrate boundary
scenarios: a cloud_isolated task's tools act inside its sandbox end to end (worker, Core, gateway, guest; the MicroVM in the hosted job)
followed processes with replay across a lost link, stdin, cancel, PTY and directory operations on both backends
proof: typed, capability-bound guest calls for processes (start, follow from a cursor, stdin, cancel, PTY) and directories, with output kept in a bounded ring so a lost link is relinked and replayed; a MicroVM pins protected paths read-only against processes; the Core's shell.exec, test.run, fs.read, fs.list and fs.stat act inside a cloud_isolated task's sandbox, which is provisioned at StartTask, named on the log and released when the task ends.
audit: PARTIAL before: one-shot exec and file reads/writes only; no sandbox path in the Core's tools.
limitations: change engine, worktrees, search and verification not yet through the sandbox (M8.7); sandbox loss recovery is M8.9; PTY streaming to a viewer is M8.8.
